profile.headline: Software Engineer ll at Findhelp
profile.summary:
With over five years of experience, I specialize in designing and implementing robust API and data pipeline solutions at Oracle, where I currently serve as a Software Engineer. My focus is on empowering the Supply Chain Planning organization with innovative technologies, ensuring data accuracy, operational efficiency, and actionable analytics. I am deeply motivated by creating seamless systems that address complex business challenges and align with Oracle's mission to drive transformation through cutting-edge solutions.  

At Oracle, I have led the development of the Global Order Promising (GOP) custom engine, leveraging SQL, PL/SQL, and Python to optimize supply chain processes such as FIFO warehouse logic, purchase order workflows, and data center capacity planning. My contributions to organization-wide ETL pipelines have played a pivotal role in delivering critical insights for forecasting and decision-making, further enhancing operational visibility across Oracle's global supply chain operations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & Scrum Master
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented the Global Order Promising Custom Engine, an enterprise-grade API and data pipeline suite built with SQL, PL/SQL, Python, Java, Oracle Cloud Platform, and Docker, delivering real-time purchase order reservation logic, inventory aging calculations, and FIFO logic to Oracle ERP
• Built a capacity-planning API in PL/SQL and Python to surface real-time data center rack availability to ERP frontends, improving supply chain visibility and reducing planning errors
Developed a multistage ELT pipeline using a microservices-based architecture with Docker and Cron scheduling, ingesting data from 3rd party APIs and document-based uploads
• Implementation resulted in 35% leaner inventory per warehouse and $15,000 saved in aging inventory within the first month
• Enhanced data quality by building an automated testing pipeline in Java and Selenium, reducing defects by 30%
• Led agile ceremonies for an 8-person SAFe team including daily stand-ups, iteration planning, ART syncs, system demos, and inspect and adapt using Jira and Confluence
• Improved on-time delivery by 15% and reduced sprint carryover by 20% by adding a structured problem-solving segment to daily stand-ups
• Protected team capacity from scope creep and ad hoc requests through backlog prioritization with the product owner, reducing missed sprints by 35%
• Improved PI predictability from 60% to 80% and reduced escalations by 15% by keeping stakeholders aligned using PI objectives, burnup charts, and Jira dashboards
• Drove continuous improvement through retrospectives, including a Confluence troubleshooting guide that cut production issue resolution time by 30%
• Onboarded and coached new team members on Scrum and SAFe practices, fostering an agile mindset across the team
positions.insights: Skills: PL/SQL · SQL · Data Integration · ETL pipeline · API design · Git · Version Control · Data Governance

positions.title: Sales & Accounting Clerk
positions.description:
• First point of contact for potential customers, answering inquiries, gathering requirements, and presenting tailored solutions for commercial door repair and maintenance services.
• Applied value-based selling methodologies, framing services around customer pain points, operational savings, safety compliance, and long-term reliability.
• Handled repeat customer accounts, ensuring strong relationships, timely service, and consistent satisfaction that helped drive long-term contracts and repeat business.
• Collaborated cross-functionally with technicians and accounting to ensure accurate job scoping, billing, and seamless service delivery.
• Built trust and credibility through clear communication and solution-oriented consultation, contributing to customer loyalty and retention.

positions.title: Actuarial Consultant Intern
positions.description:
• Benchmarked stop-loss insurance data across the South-Central U.S. region, delivering insights that summarized companywide financial performance.
• Presented stop-loss findings to key stakeholders, clearly communicating trends and recommendations that informed decision-making on employee benefits strategy.
Produced client-facing financial monitoring reports on employee benefits, helping HR and finance teams track cost efficiency and risk exposure.
• Contributed to benefits plan rollout by presenting financial plan details to employees and translating key documents (handbook, summary, and audio presentation) into Spanish, ensuring accessibility and understanding for a broader employee base.
• Built experience in financial modeling, data analysis, and stakeholder communication, laying a foundation for bridging technical expertise with business impact.

positions.title: Computer Science Course Developer
positions.description:
OnRamps offers dual enrollment for underserved high school students and teachers, with focuses on Com-puter Science, STEM courses, and further college level education.
•	Ideated and developed of new and interesting lessons for computer science students using MIT’s scratch language, ultimately allowing students with no prior knowledge of programming to build full-fledged apps like games and calculators. 
•	Developed webpages using HTML, CSS3 and ES6 JavaScript with user experience in mind, formatting and arranging all elements in a way that made it easy for thousands of high school students and teachers to follow the lesson. 
•	CS curriculum contributed to a 72% enrollment rate of OnRamps students in two- and four-year colleges, compared to 56% of "non-OnRamps" students within Texas.

projects.title: Tek Tracker
projects.description: A website that aims to provide schools in Texas, that use TEKS to have their kids study for the STAAR test, a way to have a prediction of how well the students will do on the test. We accomplish this using statistical analysis with a proprietary formula based on the TEKS distribution and weights, along with teacher input and grades of the students. The frontend is built using React, Bootstrap, Axios, and ChartJS for collecting and displaying data. The backend uses the Django Rest Framework to create an API which is used to create, read, update and delete data from the MySQL database. All code and information can be found at https://github.com/fmojica30/tektrakker.

projects.title: Movi
projects.description: Created a website with one other partner which allowed users to review movies that are about to come out, as well as display compiled reviews from professionals and other websites. The website was created using HTML5, CSS3 and ES6 javascript for the front end. The backend used PHP and MySQL to keep track of users registration, their submitted reviews, and their likes and dislikes with movies. All movies and their information was loaded dynamically using The Movie Database (TMDb) api and youtubes API to load trailers and other video reviews of the movies. Deployment is done on Digital Ocean using Nginx as a webserver and php for server side rendering. All code can be found on github at https://github.com/fmojica30/MovieReviews
